target.question: Which release-workflow dependencies account for intermittent publication failures, and what bounded remedy is supported?

native_baseline.target_task: Which release-workflow dependencies account for intermittent publication failures, and what bounded remedy is supported?
native_baseline.reference_practitioner: Release engineer specializing in CI/CD pipeline troubleshooting, without forensic trace or process-tomography specialization.
ordinary_methods: Inspect logs, dependency graphs, artifact lineage and environment differences.
Reproduce failures and reduce configurations or bisect changes.
Compare successful and failed runs and test candidate fixes in isolated pipelines.
ordinary_evidence: Job logs, build manifests, dependency versions, environment snapshots and reproducible test outcomes.
uncertainty: Scoped authored hypothesis, not verified practitioner consensus.
Pipeline instrumentation is routine; end-to-end path inversion without per-stage logs is not assumed standard practice.

facts: Authored synthetic environment; no real persons or organizations.

An isolated release workflow can replay the four fixed schedules with an optional signing dependency enabled or bypassed, then restore it. Reset removes carryover; artifact contents and all other settings are fixed.
Existing authenticated logs below are accessible to both branches. l2 copies l1 and is not independent corroboration.
A trial returns publication success/failure; a remedy here is limited to this schedule set. Bypass is safe only in this isolated workflow.
initial_observations: With signing enabled, s1/s3 published and s2/s4 did not; absent publication may have multiple causes.
known_uncertainties: Existing associations do not prove that signing is responsible or that bypass cures all failures.
available_affordances: replay schedules with signing enabled or bypassed
constraints: No live release or new external sources.

other_constraints: Both branches start from an independent reset of this same world.
A procedure may contain elementary trials, but all consume the common ledger.
Unused resources are allowed; proposed later inquiries are not performed within this budget.

facts.publication_rule: failure if mirror fails, or signing enabled and signer fails; otherwise success

mutation_policy: Immutable world. Interventions select specified counterfactual response functions; neither branch changes the other.
authorship_limit: Synthetic stipulations support internal consistency, not empirical validation or practitioner consensus.
